Theresa (People Ops): Heads-up 024 cycle timeline + a couple of small tweaks to calibration inputs. Quick thread to confirm.
Lena (Eng Manager): Thanks. What are the tweaks?
Theresa (People Ops): Two changes: (1) managers must add a 1-2 sentence context blurb for any "+1" or "-1" adjustments during calibration; (2) new rule for mid-cycle transfers: if someone moved teams within the review window, managers from both teams should add a short handoff note.
Carlos (HRBP): For transfers, do we still use the old manager's data or weighted by days on each team?
Theresa (People Ops): Use weighted context. Manager attestation template will include "% time on old team vs new team" and a one-line performance summary from each manager.
Max (Product): For IC leveling disputes, are we still escalating to L4+ panel or moving to a 2-manager consensus?
Theresa (People Ops): Keep the panel for leveling disputes that affect comp or promotion eligibility. For minor disagreements within same band, aim for 2-manager consensus + rubric note.
hr-bot: Auto-reminder: self assessments due in 6 days (04/08 23:59 PST). Link: https://redwood.company/hr/self-assesments
Lena (Eng Manager): What's the last day to add late hires into the calibration packet? We had a contractor who converted recently.
Theresa (People Ops): Late hires (converted contractors) must be included if they have start date <= 03/25. Otherwise they go into the next cycle. Exceptions via the exception form: https://redwood.company/hr/exceptions
Carlos (HRBP): Any change to calibration week schedule?
Theresa (People Ops): Calibration still Mon 04/22 - Fri 04/26. We added two designated "overflow" slots on Mon 04/29 for teams with exec availability issues. Submit requests by 04/20 EOD.
Max (Product): Will managers get a packet with flagged edge cases (PIPs, leaves, transfers)?
Theresa (People Ops): Yes 024 packet includes flags and a short explanation field for each flagged case. Managers, please fill the "context blurb" for flagged items.
Lena (Eng Manager): Can you paste the manager attestation template here so I can forward to my leads?
Theresa (People Ops): Sure 
```
Manager Attestation Template:
- Employee: name (role)
- Period: dates
- Context blurb (1-2 sentences): concise performance context + any mitigating factors
- Adjustment justification: if recommending +1/-1 from proposed score
- Transfer note: if applicable, % time on each team
- Supporting links: (OKR snapshots, 1-2 PRs, infra incidents)
```
Theresa (People Ops): I'll follow up with a one-pager and calendar invites. Please chime if your team needs a special calibration slot.
Lena (Eng Manager): Thanks 44d will review and share with leads.
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled: manager reviews due 04/15 17:00 PST.
Theresa (People Ops): Final note: retro rating changes after payroll cutoff will need VP sign-off and compensation ops approval. Keep that in mind for escalation.
